name: hermes-agent
note: Reference only; the packaged sources are upstream's v0.23.1 tag tarball and the pnpm archives pm/lock.json pins, fetched from their own project URLs, not from AUR. The six .patch files plus system-tools.py, hermes_agent_env.py, hermes-desktop and launcher.test.cjs are copied from the two AUR recipes (0BSD); AUR/hermes-agent-bin wording in their user-visible strings is reworded for a pacman-managed install, and prepare() still points the launcher at _electron.
local_adaptations: One recipe base (pkgbase=hermes-agent) emitting hermes-agent and hermes-agent-desktop, so the desktop output can never be published against an older agent than itself; the single pnpm install in prepare() covers the web, ui-tui and desktop workspaces at once.
No -bin twins: Shelly publishes built packages, so the AUR's provides=/conflicts= dance between source and -bin variants is dropped and the desktop output simply depends on hermes-agent>=pkgver.

Electron comes from devario-libs/electron44-bin, which provides electron44=44.11.3 in the /usr/lib/electronNN layout prepare() expects; upstream's locked 44.9.3 is only staged into node_modules for the packager, never shipped.
makedepends name what the build runs (nodejs, npm, python, uv, rsync, cmake) plus gcc, make and pkgconf for node-pty's node-gyp build; the pinned pnpm archives supply node-gyp itself, as pm does.
The install stamp is written with --source pkg instead of --source aur; distribution stays pacman and updateMechanism external, so hermes update refuses and names the package manager.
